dialog.speaker: user2
dialog.text: Sometimes my plan changes without warning. The meeting moves, the route is closed, the day looks different than I expected. When that happens, my chest gets tight. My thoughts speed up. This is anxiety. It is not a flaw. It is my brain working hard to handle something unexpected.

dialog.speaker: user2
dialog.text: Here is what I can do. I find a quiet spot, even just my desk or a corner. I put both feet flat on the floor. I press my palms together for ten seconds. Then I breathe in slowly while I count five. I breathe out for five. I do this five times. The signals quiet down.

dialog.speaker: user2
dialog.text: I have handled changes before. The schedule shift last month. The new manager last year. The train delay last week. I figured each one out. I do not have to like change to be capable of change. I can take this one step at a time.
